outcome.analysis_limit: The calls establish the behavior exposed by this connected client at capture time. They do not establish why that client rejected the selector or whether another client registration has the same behavior.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A caller cannot reliably reselect an authenticated session after losing local context
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Control LocalEnvironmentMCP continuation and project-session selection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The connected client rejected the exact-session argument on the direct continuation route and returned three campaign choices on a session-scoped context request, even though the requested session identity was known.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Refresh or otherwise align the active client adapter with the merged exact-session continuation contract, then repeat this readback before assessing whether the pressure is relieved.
